questions.prompt: How much notice may OpenAI give before it retires a preview model?

options.text: At least 6 months, the same as for every other kind of model
options.explanation: Six months is the minimum for generally available models. Previews can go faster.

options.text: Much shorter notice than for other models, such as 2 weeks
options.explanation: Right. The OpenAI docs say preview models may be retired with much shorter notice, such as 2 weeks.

options.text: No notice at all, because previews are never listed on any page
options.explanation: Previews are covered on the deprecations page. They may just get less time.

questions.prompt: The OpenAI docs describe the normal way to replace an API key. What is the order?

options.text: Revoke the old key, then create a new one, then update the apps
options.explanation: That order leaves the apps without a working key for a while.

options.text: Create a replacement, revoke the old key at once, then update the apps
options.explanation: That leaves the apps on a revoked key until they are updated. OpenAI revokes the old key only after the replacement works.

options.text: Create a replacement, update the apps, then revoke the old key once it works
options.explanation: Right. The OpenAI docs say to create a replacement, update your applications, and revoke the old key after you verify the new one works.

questions.prompt: What do the Gemini API docs say to plan before launch, because testing can never guarantee perfection?

options.text: How you will spot problems, and how you will deal with them
options.explanation: Right. The Gemini API docs say to plan upfront how you will spot and deal with problems that arise.

options.text: Nothing, because enough testing removes every problem
options.explanation: The Gemini API docs say you can never guarantee perfection, however much you test.

options.text: Only how to answer the press once a problem is public
options.explanation: Google's advice is about spotting problems early, for example with a monitored feedback channel.
